ownership.costBasisAssumption: Owner answered 35 when asked what was paid. Item and total paid are both recorded at that stated amount; no separate tax or shipping charges were supplied.
ownership.condition: Displayed in owner photos. A complete condition inspection and packaging check were not supplied.

market.liquidityBasis: Provisional qualitative estimate from sparse exact-match listings and auction evidence; time to sale is unverified.
market.reason: Low confidence. Used display-piece estimate, assuming intact crossbow and base; box unconfirmed. Modeled $60 low / $100 mid / $160 high before seller fees, shipping and tax. Exact Joelle Jones used eBay ask $180 plus $20 shipping; sold-out BBTS price $99.99 is historical retail, not available stock or a sale comparable. UK £25/£30 hammer records concern the same numbered example, later described with a missing string, and are excluded from intact US valuation. No matching intact US sold range verified.
